title: The Renaissance
key_facts: Cultural rebirth emphasizing humanism and classical antiquity
Flourishing of art, architecture, science, and literature
Spread from Italian city-states to wider Europe via trade and print
causes: Recovery from late medieval crises and growing urban wealth
Patronage systems (e.g., Medici) and competition among city-states
Rediscovery of classical texts and techniques
outcome: Advances in science and inquiry that laid groundwork for the Scientific Revolution
Humanist education and spread of ideas via the printing press
impacts: Transformation of European art, education, and intellectual life
Catalyst for Reformation and Scientific Revolution
Influence on exploration, cartography, and statecraft
